tasks.label: tail-clientlog-start
args: $env:VGE_DATA_PATH = '${config:vsmod.debugGame.dataPath}'; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:VGE_DATA_PATH) -or -not [System.IO.Path]::IsPathFullyQualified($env:VGE_DATA_PATH)) { throw 'Set VGE_DATA_PATH to an absolute automation data directory and restart the IDE.' }; $log = Join-Path $env:VGE_DATA_PATH 'Logs/client-debug.log'; $sentinel = '== VSLOGTAIL STOP =='; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $log) | Out-Null; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $log)) { New-Item -ItemType File -Path $log | Out-Null }; Write-Host '== VSLOGTAIL BEGIN =='; Write-Host $log; Write-Host '== VSLOGTAIL READY =='; Get-Content -Path $log -Tail 50 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }; $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($log, [System.IO.FileMode]::Open, [System.IO.FileAccess]::Read, [System.IO.FileShare]::ReadWrite); try { $fs.Seek(0, [System.IO.SeekOrigin]::End) | Out-Null; $sr = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($fs); while($true) { $line = $sr.ReadLine(); if($null -ne $line) { if($line -eq $sentinel) { break }; Write-Host $line } else { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200 } } } finally { if($sr) { $sr.Dispose() }; $fs.Dispose() }; Write-Host '== VSLOGTAIL STOPPED =='

tasks.label: tail-clientlog-stop
args: $env:VGE_DATA_PATH = '${config:vsmod.debugGame.dataPath}'; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:VGE_DATA_PATH) -or -not [System.IO.Path]::IsPathFullyQualified($env:VGE_DATA_PATH)) { throw 'Set VGE_DATA_PATH to an absolute automation data directory and restart the IDE.' }; $log = Join-Path $env:VGE_DATA_PATH 'Logs/client-debug.log'; Add-Content -Path $log -Value '== VSLOGTAIL STOP =='; Write-Host '== VSLOGTAIL STOP SIGNALLED =='

tasks.label: scan-clientlog
args: $env:VGE_DATA_PATH = '${config:vsmod.debugGame.dataPath}'; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:VGE_DATA_PATH) -or -not [System.IO.Path]::IsPathFullyQualified($env:VGE_DATA_PATH)) { throw 'Set VGE_DATA_PATH to an absolute automation data directory and restart the IDE.' }; $log = Join-Path $env:VGE_DATA_PATH 'Logs/client-debug.log'; if (-not (Test-Path $log)) { exit 0 }; $i = 0; Get-Content -Path $log | ForEach-Object { $i++; $l = $_; if($l -eq '== VSLOGTAIL STOP ==') { return }; if($l -match '\[(?:Error|VGE)\]') { Write-Host ('{0}:{1}: {2}' -f $log, $i, $l) } }
